verdict.rationale: There is no explicit no-training policy or AI-training opt-out in the evidence. The only relevant controls are indirect. Meilisearch can be self-hosted as a single binary on your own machines, which keeps documents under your control [docs-11, docs-44]. Default telemetry can also be turned off with MEILI_NO_ANALYTICS [comm-12]. Data may still go to third-party embedding providers such as OpenAI when embedders are configured [comm-20]. Missing for 10: an explicit first-party statement that customer data is not used for model training, a training opt-out or data-use policy for Meilisearch Cloud, and guidance on third-party embedder data handling.
